meta.method: Scope: threats published in the last `window_days` of the DATA (anchored to the newest published_at, so offline caches give the same answer every day) plus every KEV entry, OTX pulse, CERT-In advisory and ransomware record. Plain NVD CVEs only count if they show activity (KEV / public exploit / EPSS >= nvd_min_epss) or are named by another in-scope item: thousands of unexploited CVEs with boilerplate text are a vulnerability class, not a campaign.
